title: Simulador Oficial Completo TOEIC® - Versión 1
description: Simulador completo real de Listening & Reading enfocado en Zenith Corp y el líder the Sales Director.

parts.visual:
## 📝 Simulador Oficial TOEIC® (Versión 1)

Evaluación de **Listening & Reading** en tiempo real:

1. **Listening Section**: Evalúa tu comprensión en Zenith Corp usando ApexCRM.
2. **Reading Section**: Mide tu análisis gramatical de memorandos emitidos por the Sales Director.

*Inicia tu prueba simulada oficial.*
parts.audio: Welcome to the Full TOEIC Simulation. Manage your time efficiently across both listening and reading stages. Let's begin.

questions.question: [PART 1 - PHOTO]: Select the best description of Zenith Corp's office photo.
questions.audio_script: A) They are discussing the CRM dashboard. B) They are leaving the main lobby. C) The server room is closed. D) They are filing paper documents.
questions.explanation: La descripción correcta es la A, ya que se observa a los representantes analizando el panel del CRM.

questions.question: [PART 3 - CONVERSATION]: Listen to the dialogue and answer: What does the man agree to do next?
questions.audio_script:
M: Hi Sarah, did you get a chance to review the shipment contract from Zenith Corp?
W: I did. Their pricing is competitive, but their delivery window is too narrow for our schedule.
M: I see. I will call the Sales Director to negotiate an extension.
options: Sign the contract as currently written.
Call the manager to negotiate an extension of the delivery window.
Write a new memorandum to sales staff.
questions.correct_answer: Call the manager to negotiate an extension of the delivery window.
questions.explanation: El hombre dice: 'I will call their manager to negotiate an extension'.

questions.question:
[PART 5]: Complete the business sentence correctly:

"All employees are strictly required to comply ___ the updated security rules in ApexCRM."
questions.explanation: El verbo 'comply' rige gramaticalmente la preposición 'with' (comply with / cumplir con).

questions.question:
[PART 7]: Read the memorandum and answer: **When will the migration to ApexCRM officially occur?**

**MEMORANDUM**

*To:* Sales Representatives
*From:* Sales Department
*Subject: CRM Software Transition*

Please note that starting next Monday, we are officially retiring our legacy sales tool and migrating to ApexCRM. An interactive onboarding session will be held this Thursday at 10:00 AM in Conference Room B. Attendance is mandatory.
questions.explanation: El memorando dice: 'starting next Monday, we are officially retiring our legacy sales tool and migrating to ApexCRM'.
